new.s: Anantapur was the headquarters of which of the following from 1800 to 1807?
new.x: From 1800 to 1807 the Ceded Districts formed a single collectorate under Munro with its headquarters at Anantapur.
new.angle: U0169 #5/#9 Ceded Districts -> headquarters town

new.s: Into which two collectorates were the Ceded Districts split in 1808?
new.x: In 1808 the single Ceded Districts collectorate was divided into Bellary and Cuddapah.
new.angle: U0169 #5 Ceded Districts -> headquarters / collectorates

new.s: How many collectorates did coastal Andhra have in 1794?
new.x: In 1794 coastal Andhra had five collectorates: Ganjam, Visakhapatnam, Godavari, Krishna and Nellore.
new.angle: U0169 #2/#17 Collectorates -> number

new.s: Which of the following was NOT among the eight collectorates of Andhra by 1856?
new.x: By 1856 the eight collectorates were Ganjam, Visakhapatnam, Godavari, Krishna, Nellore, Bellary, Cuddapah and Kurnool; Anantapur district came only in 1882.
new.angle: U0169 #2/#17 Collectorates by 1856 -> names

new.s:

1. Committee of Circuit ordered
2. Treaty of Masulipatnam
3. Madras Board of Revenue set up
4. Munro made Principal Collector of the Ceded Districts
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
new.x: Treaty of Masulipatnam 1768, Committee of Circuit 1775, Board of Revenue 1786 and Munro as Principal Collector 1800.
new.angle: U0169 #1 Chronology of Andhra colonial events

new.s: Who among the following was made 'Rao Bahadur' for helping Sir Arthur Cotton build the Dowleswaram anicut?
new.x: Veenam Veeranna was Cotton's Indian officer at Dowleswaram and was made Rao Bahadur and Assistant Engineer.
new.angle: U0170 #1 Anicuts -> Indian assistant; PYQ ya7df2f7359d angle

new.s: Who proposed the Ramapada Sagaram project, the forerunner of today's Polavaram project?
new.x: Ramapada Sagaram, the forerunner of Polavaram, was proposed by Sir Shonthi Venkataramamurthy.
new.angle: U0170 #1 Ramapada Sagaram -> proposer

new.s: In which year was the main work of the Dowleswaram anicut on the Godavari completed?
new.x: Work on Dowleswaram began in 1847 and the main work was completed in April 1852; 1855 is the Krishna anicut.
new.angle: U0170 #1 Anicuts -> year

new.s: Which was the first railway line in Andhra, opened in 1862?
new.x: The first railway in Andhra was the Puttur–Renigunta line of the Madras Railway, 1862.
new.angle: U0170 #3 Railways -> first line/year

new.s: On which of the following grounds did the British take over Coorg and Awadh?
new.x: Coorg (1834) and Awadh (1856) were taken over on the ground of misgovernance, one of the grounds for British intervention in the states.
new.angle: U0171 #5 Paramountcy -> grounds for intervention; PYQ y0ed4b903fa8 angle

new.s: At which battle did Sir Charles Napier defeat the Amirs of Sindh?
new.x: Napier defeated the Amirs of Sindh at Miani (and Dabo), and Sindh was annexed in 1843.
new.angle: U0171 #6 Conquest of Sindh -> battle of Miani

new.s:

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Tipu sent ambassadors to France for European technology and also built a navy.

new.s: Which French revolutionary club is Tipu Sultan said to have joined?
new.x: Tipu Sultan is said to have joined the Jacobin Club and planted a 'Tree of Liberty' at Srirangapatnam.
